findings.message: 19.P4.provider-cooldown-failover requires a pre-dispatch infra_error transition carrying provider_drought without a running offer. The existing auditor reports "terminal 'infra_error' has no open run" for that exact record, conflicting with section 15's green-auditor requirement for fake-driven production evidence. Repair requires changing the unfenced auditor.
findings.paved_road: Clarify the governing entry's audit treatment of structured pre-dispatch drought parks and extend the ticket's fence to chupa/audit.py and tests/test_audit.py, preserving ordinary missing-run and duplicate-terminal detection.
